fonts.usage: Headings (H1-H4), giving a strong, authoritative, modern feel.
Data, timestamps, logs, overlines, live metrics, giving a technical/surveillance terminal vibe.

colors.strategy: Deep charcoal/navy background to reduce glare. Neon accents used strictly for functional status indicators (Normal, Warning, Critical) to draw immediate attention.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid (Mode B). Dense, strict hierarchy, every pixel utilized. Use max screen height where possible for the main dashboard view.
layout_and_spacing.border_style: 1px solid subtle border, 'Grid Borders' technical look

components.cards: Flat background (bg-surface), sharp corners (rounded-sm), 1px solid subtle border, no drop shadow. Hover state: slight border color shift.
components.alerts_and_badges: High contrast text with 15-20% opacity background of the severity color, sharp borders.
components.buttons: Square edges, solid high-contrast backgrounds for primary CTA. Use icon-only or icon+text. Hover: slight scaling or opacity shift.
components.camera_feeds: Aspect ratio 16:9, border ring based on AI detection status (e.g. flashing red border on critical anomaly). Overlay timestamps and AI data using IBM Plex Mono.
components.charts: Recharts with dark mode palette. Minimal grid lines (dashed, low opacity). Tooltips must have solid dark background with 1px border.
components.incident_log: Dense list layout. Use colored vertical left-borders on list items corresponding to incident severity.

motion.micro_interactions: Fast, precise, no bouncy animations. Use linear or sharp ease curves.
motion.camera_feed_update: Flicker/glitch subtle effect on load or status change to mimic real feeds.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Set the overall app theme to 'dark'.
Ensure all cards use sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm max) and have a 1px solid subtle border (border-border). Avoid soft shadows entirely.
Implement the live camera grid using the 'Control Room' bento pattern: 1 large dominant feed, smaller secondary feeds on the side or in a grid.
Real-time object detection bounding boxes (TensorFlow.js) should map to the severity colors (e.g. green box for persons, red box for unauthorized/anomaly).
All timestamps, system metrics, and live data MUST use the 'IBM Plex Mono' font.
DO NOT USE ANY PLACEHOLDER IMAGES (no placehold.it, no dummyimage). Use the provided image_urls for the mock camera feeds.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='camera-select-dropdown', data-testid='alert-resolve-btn').
